The Classroom of the Black Cat and a Witch

show:the car.name: The Car Chasers
show:the car.summary: Buying a classic or exotic car, fixing it up and selling it equals profit. It seems like a good formula to make money, but it's not as easy as it sounds, to which Jeff Allen and Perry Barndt can attest. As they prove, it takes a certain type of person who's willing to take a gamble in order to make money in the car-flipping business, because a flip doesn't always result in profit. Jeff and Perry travel the country looking for cars they can buy low and eventually - they hope - sell high.

episodes:14237.name: Stacks of Cash and a Hidden Stash
Put Your Money Where Your Mouth Is
The Rarest Cars You'll Ever See
Three Great Cares - One Big Problem
New Kids on the Auction Block

show:dracula.name: Dracula
show:dracula.summary: In Transylvania in 1897, the blood drinking Count is drawing his plans against Victorian London. And be warned: the dead travel fast.

episodes:37453.name: The Rules of the Beast
episodes:37453.summary: 1897. English lawyer Jonathan Harker travels to Transylvania to meet a new client - and a legend is about to get fresh blood...

episodes:37453.name: Blood Vessel
episodes:37453.summary: The Russian ship The Demeter is a perfectly ordinary vessel, but her new voyage seems different. A motley collection of remarkable passengers includes one Count Dracula. Soon the crew are locked in a life-or-death struggle to stop the vampire before he reaches England. The ship of death has a new captain...

episodes:37453.name: The Dark Compass
episodes:37453.summary: Count Dracula has made it to England—a new world pulsing with fresh blood—and lays his plans to spread his foul vampire contagion. But why does he set his sights on the seemingly ordinary Lucy Westenra? And who on earth is left to stop him?

show:frankenstein.name: Frankenstein
show:frankenstein.summary: Adaption of Mary Shelley's novel about a scientist who brings life to a creature fashioned from corpses and various body parts.

show:tales from the void.name: Tales From The Void
show:tales from the void.summary:
Tales From The Void is an episodic horror anthology series adapted from the most viral and haunting stories from the depths of the internet. Based on stories from the r/NoSleep community, each tale blends genre thrills with social commentary to explore the darker side of the human psyche.

From creepy dolls to unborn children, unexplained invasions to paranormal hauntings, unsolved mysteries to serial murders, Tales From The Void draws from a wide spectrum of horror sub-genres with each episode paying homage to a classic and cult films from the eighties and nineties.

Unnerving, uncompromising, and rooted in character, Tales From The Void finds all the ways to keep you up at night.

episodes:79956.name: Into the Unknown
episodes:79956.summary:
When a mysterious black square appears in the middle of an apartment complex, suspicions develop between neighbours about the horrors it may bring. As mistrust grows, they slowly learn that the square isn't the only thing to be afraid of.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "The Black Square" by Matthew Dymerski.

episodes:79956.name: Fixed Frequency
episodes:79956.summary:
Juan and his friends spend their evenings hacking baby monitors and scaring young parents, but what happens when there's someone sinister on the other line?

Based on the r/NoSleep story "I Used to Hack Baby Monitors, One Night I Learned My Lesson" by Manen Lyset.

episodes:79956.name: Starlight
episodes:79956.summary:
Whit Barnett has always wanted to be a star, and the new game show The Magnificent Million Dollar Question seems like it could offer him that opportunity. But the show's conceit may be far darker than he could have imagined.

Based on the r/NoSleep story: "The Million Dollar Question" by Joao Ribiero.

episodes:79956.name: Carry
episodes:79956.summary:
Katie is thrilled when she learns she's pregnant, fulfilling her lifelong dream of becoming a mother. But when she learns her unborn child isn't viable, she finds that termination is not in line with her religious community's expectations.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "Pro-Life" by Grayson Grume.

episodes:79956.name: Plastic Smile
episodes:79956.summary:
Growing up with addicts for parents, Abigail's only solace is an odd porcelain doll named Betsy. Only Betsy isn't like other dolls. She moves, speaks, cries - and Betsy wants Abigail to bring her to a dark tunnel in middle of the woods.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "Betsy the Doll" by Rebecca Klingel.

episodes:79956.name: Whistle in the Woods
episodes:79956.summary:
Sawyer would love nothing more than to have a sleepover with her new best friend, Nola, in her giant, bougie home. But Nola's house has rules that must be followed. Rules that conceal a dark secret that arrives each night at 3:03 AM.

Based on the r/NoSleep story "Something Walks Whistling Past My House Every Night at 3:03" by Travis Brown.

show:the trouble with tessa.name: The Trouble with Tessa
show:the trouble with tessa.summary:
After Tessa Fowler's skyrocketing career implodes overnight, the disgraced documentarian escapes to a small, idyllic mountain town called Lowery. It seems like the perfect place to hide: Lowery doesn't allow cellphones, doesn't have internet, and no one knows about Tessa's past.

Tessa's determination to leave their investigative days behind them disappears, however, when they find a mysterious box of recordings in their rental home's dingy basement. At first, the recordings seem to be nothing more than security footage. However, when Tessa plays a tape that appears to catch a murder in progress, they can't help but start digging into this seemingly perfect town's disturbing past.

episodes:86017.name: Part One: Tessa
episodes:86017.summary: Disgraced documentarian Tessa Fowler arrives in Lowery, a quirky rural town with minimal technology, a list of rules, and a bizarre curfew siren that blares every night. Anxious to escape the city after a recent high-profile career scandal, Tessa is just happy to be someplace quiet and isolated. After their second night of hearing unsettling noises coming from the home's dingy basement, Tessa heads downstairs to investigate and discovers a mysterious box of old VHS and audio tapes. At first, the recordings seem to be nothing more than security footage captured by a paranoid former tenant. However, when Tessa plays an audio tape that appears to have caught a murder in progress, their investigative instincts jump back into action.

episodes:86017.name: Part Two: Lowery
episodes:86017.summary: After spending a night going through the mysterious tapes, Tessa wakes up to more bad news from their producer, Aaron. Aaron sees lucrative potential in these new tapes - especially with the pair's impending legal fees. Tessa heads to the town's library to begin their research, only to discover that someone has ensured Lowery's past stays hidden. But Tessa finds a reference to a missing woman named Amelia Stokes who lived in the house they're currently renting. When Tessa's trip to a nearby bar doesn't go as planned, one local finally warms up to them, giving them a glimpse into Lowery's dark history.

episodes:86017.name: Part Three: The Bone King
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa comes clean about why they ran to away to Lowery, agrees to meet Freddy before curfew, and faces new threats as the strange walls of Lowery begin to close in.

episodes:86017.name: Part Four: Heir
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa returns to find that someone has taken the tapes. As strange noises rise from the basement, a surprise visit from Betsy changes everything.

episodes:86017.name: Part Five: Alone
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa's risky decision to recover stolen property leads to them getting trapped in a place not meant to be found—or escaped.

episodes:86017.name: Part Six: Troubles
episodes:86017.summary: Tessa finally learns the truth they've been chasing all along—one that changes everything they thought they knew about Amelia's fate.

show:the changeling.name: The Changeling
show:the changeling.summary: Set in a New York City no one knew existed, The Changeling focuses on the death-defying odyssey of Apollo Kagwa and Emma Valentine as they look to find out what happened to the son who was removed from them. On their voyage, they will travel through enchanted isles and haunted woodlands, meet glowing witches, demon giants and racist cops. They'll deal with the perils of personal technology and social media, toxic masculinity, the mental health of new mothers and fathers and find out if surviving a fairytale is as brutal as simply surviving in Trumplandia.

episodes:37128.name: First Comes Love
episodes:37128.summary: A bookseller from Queens meets a librarian from Virginia. They fall in love, marry, have a baby—and trigger an unimaginable series of events.

episodes:37128.name: Then Comes a Baby in a Baby Carriage
episodes:37128.summary: The exhaustion of new parenthood is taking its toll on Emma and Apollo. To make matters worse, Emma starts getting strange texts.
Emma does the unthinkable. Apollo tries to find meaning in the aftermath—and finally decides what to do with his valuable book.

episodes:37128.name: The Wise Ones
episodes:37128.summary: Apollo and Patrice make a sale to William Wheeler, who later gives Apollo stunning news.

episodes:37128.name: This Woman's Work
episodes:37128.summary: The mysterious washerwoman's ominous words leave a lasting impression. Apollo comes face-to-face with his true enemy.

episodes:37128.name: Aftermath
episodes:37128.summary: Emma finds Cal and the Wise Ones on North Brother Island, where she pieces together clues to locate a special place.

episodes:37128.name: Stormy Weather
episodes:37128.summary: Lillian reckons with a dark night from her past and records a message for her son, Apollo.

episodes:37128.name: Battle of the Island
episodes:37128.summary: Season finale. Kinder Garten's fury rips across the island, sending Cal, Apollo, and the others out into the darkness.

show:13 nights of elvira.name: 13 Nights of Elvira
show:13 nights of elvira.summary: Break out the crucifix, get some garlic, and say your prayers cause Elvira's coming for a visit. Elvira takes on some of the best of the worst modern B movies like Puppet Master, Cannibal Women in the Avacodo, Jungle of Death, and Evil Bong! Skewering them in the sexy, spooky way that only she can.

episodes:71116.name: Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death

show:hackers.name: Hackers of CypherCon
show:hackers.summary: CypherCon is an annual hacker conference held in Wisconsin that provides hackers with an outlet to openly demonstrate and experience creativity and ingenuity through hands-on enlightening activities, thought provoking presentations and technical projects.

previousepisode.name: The X-15 Rocket Plane, Flying the First Wings into Space with Michelle Evans

episodes:43872.name: Hacking, Phreaking & Juvenile Delinquency with Joe Grand
episodes:43872.summary: In a time when tinkering with technology was a guarantee for ridicule and torment, a small group of curious explorers were connecting to computer systems, traversing the telephone network, and occasionally causing mischief. Joe shares unheard stories of his early days as a hacker, phone phreak, and troublemaker, following a rebellious path towards the eventual redirection of his passion for good.

episodes:43872.name: Hacking a Better Tomorrow with Ben Heck
episodes:43872.summary: A self-taught hacker, modder and maker Benjamin Heckendorn - better known as Ben Heck is host of element14's The Ben Heck Show, a weekly web series in which Ben tackles fun and interesting projects across a wide range of topics. In this exclusive CypherCon 3.0 key note presentation, Ben discusses his beginnings, where he is today and how you can help hack a better tomorrow.

episodes:43872.name: Forensics When You're Broke with Phil Cochran
episodes:43872.summary: Exploring the forensic methodology and tasks using free open source software. We won't be focusing on what tools are available, the focus of the presentation is explaining the methodology and where these tools fit in to the process to get the job done.

episodes:43872.name: Hack in the Day with Brad Swanson
episodes:43872.summary: This talk will be about hacking/phreaking in the late 1980's, early 1990's, and what the scene was like back then compared to today. What was considered cutting edge back then has either changed or disappeared entirely. The general attitude around hacking, and hacking 'groups' has matured and evolved over the years. Some of the origins of how we got to where we are today is covered.

episodes:43872.name: Developer Friendly Cryptography with Brice Williams
episodes:43872.summary: Brice Williams will look at some common cryptography usage errors and why popular libraries often fall short. He will also discuss nuances such as backwards compatibility, FIPS 140-2 validation, and weak standards such as JOSE/JWT that contribute to the overall confusion. Advice is also provided to ensure more secure cryptographic implementations are used.

episodes:43872.name: Hacking Academia with Anita Nikolich
episodes:43872.summary: Anita will present some ideas about how three communities with different incentives, yet the same goals, can work together to shorten the time to discovery and overcome many of the obstacles that impeded progress in the sciences centuries earlier.

episodes:43872.name: Attacking Wireless Devices Using SDR with Caleb Madrigal
episodes:43872.summary: In this talk, we'll be exploring how wireless communication works. We'll capture digital data live (with Software-Defined Radio [SDR]), and see how the actual bits are transmitted. From here, we'll see how to view, listen to, manipulate, and replay wireless signals. We'll also look at interrupting wireless communication, and finally, we'll even generate new radio waves from scratch.

episodes:43872.name: SOAR: Operating at Attacker Speed with Brian Genz & Ben Zimmerman
episodes:43872.summary: Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) enables defenders to operate at attacker speed by codifying detection and response expertise into automation playbooks. We will examine the core components of SOAR, skills required to design and implement it, common use cases in detection and response, and potential opportunities for security control testing in a defense-in-depth environment.

episodes:43872.name: When Developers Fail to Secure with David Bryan
episodes:43872.summary: David has found some pretty stupid security mistakes. Blatantly overlooked controls, or flat out lazy system admins. David will show real-world examples of misuse & abuse, and improper data handling of passwords inside application code. We must remember a breech in one security system, can lead to a breach on another system because of the implicit trust relationships we build to get the job done.

episodes:43872.name: What the Fungi? How to Grow Your Own Nootropics with Eric Zimmermann
episodes:43872.summary: Learn how mushrooms are medicinal and doing some amazing things like fighting cancer, boosting immunity, improving cognition, etc. In this presentation learn which compounds mushrooms produce that are medicinal and how you can easily grow them at home. We'll review the latest research from clinical trials and unveil the low cost, high yield techniques gleaned from anonymous mushroom cultivators.

episodes:43872.name: Text Mining: Reading Between the Lines with John Platais
episodes:43872.summary: "Read between the lines" usually refers to one's ability to infer hidden meaning from text. This talk will look at the tools and efforts needed for "Text Mining". Using data mining techniques to infer meaning, misconceptions, or hidden agendas from common documents. Learn a general understanding of the process along with a list of tools & services to start text mining right away.

episodes:43872.name: SAEDY - Subversion & Espionage Directed Against You with Judy Towers
episodes:43872.summary: Espionage is the practice of secretly gathering information about a foreign government or a competing industry, with the objective of placing one's own government or corporation at a strategic or financial advantage. Presenting case examples of military and industrial espionage, Judy illustrates how tricks of the spy trade are parleyed against ordinary individuals every day.

episodes:43872.name: The Arms Race with Ken Grigas
episodes:43872.summary: United States military veteran Ken Grigas talks about his time in service during the "Cold War" between the Unites States and U.S.S.R.

episodes:43872.name: Alice in ICSLand with Lesley Carhart & Mark Stacey
episodes:43872.summary: The past decade has made it clear that threats of cyber attacks on Industrial Control Systems (ICS) is real, and poses a fundamental risk to our way of life. The demand of ICS security professionals far exceeds the supply. Mark and Lesley of Dragos Inc. will provide an overview of some great ways to learn about the operational and technical aspects of ICS networks without breaking the bank.

episodes:43872.name: How to "Theoretically" Kill a Continent with Michelle Meas
episodes:43872.summary: The human body is terrifyingly vulnerable. With the rise of novel gene-editing techniques and our increasing knowledge of genomics, we are forced to confront the idea of a microscopic enemy. This talk will explore the not-so-theoretical aftermath of an unchecked pandemic of unknown origin, the monsters we created in our own medical hubris, and the ever-present threat of bio-terrorism.

episodes:43872.name: Embedding Security with Mike Kavka
episodes:43872.summary: Sequestered, cordoned off, separated, even out of touch. These words have been used by plenty of non-infosec folks. From Dev teams to Admins, Sales people and more, we get looked at as these mystical people who say nO! The people who are stopping others from doing their job. Maybe it is time for our team to take a different approach...

episodes:43872.name: Handshakes & Hashes, Plucking Passwords from Thin Air with Robert Reif and Shannon Fritz
episodes:43872.summary: New developments in Hashcat have brought some new WiFi attack techniques to light. We've taken concepts from classic WiFi attacks, added a little special sauce, and created a whole new attack vector for WiFi devices everywhere. All it takes is a friendly introduction and a little cracking time to gain access to protected networks. Come get some code and that uneasy feeling of being vulnerable.

episodes:43872.name: Hidden in Plain Sight, Steganography & Digital Watermarking with Ryan Fox
episodes:43872.summary: Steganography is the practice of hiding a message "in plain sight" inside an image, video, sound, text, or file. The practice goes back centuries, and in recent years has seen a rise in use for digital watermarking. It can be used for communication, leak prevention, or copyright protection. We'll look at techniques, analysis, and detection through the lens of digital watermarking.

episodes:43872.name: An Interdisciplinary View of Risk, Applications for Security with Susan Lincke
episodes:43872.summary: In 2016, 791,820,040 data records were breached in the United States, which averages two breaches per American. France, Canada and Taiwan also encountered breaches above or near their population levels - or double it. This begs the question: are we doing and spending enough for security? This study of ethical risk considers how to calculate risk and engineer solutions for this new environment.

episodes:43872.name: Hack Dumberly Not Smarterer with Tim Medin
episodes:43872.summary: Tim Medin discuss the dumbest red team tricks and hacks encountered over the years. We are going to take the A out of APT, because so few attackers really need to use advanced techniques. We'll also discuss the simple defenses that make an attacker's life much more difficult.

episodes:43872.name: Crypt-Oh No with Zach Grace
episodes:43872.summary: Even when the right crypto primitives are chosen, subtle programming mistakes can lead to issues with the efficacy of the encryption. This presentation is aimed at helping developers avoid common cryptography pitfalls when encrypting sensitive data by giving guidance on what algorithms to choose and identifying common implementation issues observed in real-world applications.

episodes:43872.name: A Kinesthetic Approach to Learning Encryption with Antoinette Stevens
episodes:43872.summary: Kinesthetic style, or tactile learning, means that some learn best by physically doing to fully learn and memorize a topic. Capture the flag competitions can be a way to understand security concepts with reading, understanding, applying and watching it in action. Creating a full multi-sensory learning experience to retain those concepts in memory for later.

episodes:43872.name: More Than Tor: Shining a Light on Different Corners of the Dark Web with Benjamin Brown
episodes:43872.summary: When the terms Darknet or Dark Web are invoked, it is almost always in reference to the Tor network, but what about the other extant Darknet frameworks? In this talk Benjamin will expand the field of view to include frameworks such as Freenet, I2P, and OpenBazaar. He'll take a quick look at the origins and technical underpinnings of these Darknets as well as their actors and offerings.

episodes:43872.name: The Magic of Forensic Artifacts Hiding in Plain Sight with Cindy Murphy
episodes:43872.summary: Digital forensics expert Cindy Murphy, M.Sc. will use this session to unpack the myths of digital forensics she uncovered since her career pivot from law enforcement to private digital forensics work. She will discuss how to navigate common myths and most importantly, how to keep moving forward in an ever-changing industry.

episodes:43872.name: Spitting the Hook: Examining Phishing Bait with Joe Cicero
episodes:43872.summary: In this very informative panel, Joe Cicero examines phishing bait for enterprise protection. Subjects covered are: the red flag concept, identifying phishing email basics, examining headers, examining attachments and links. Additional topics covered are: the differences between a legit email, spam, marketing and phishing.

episodes:43872.name: Phreaking for Fun and Profit with Brad Swanson
episodes:43872.summary: Brad talk's about phone phreaking back in the late 1980's, until the mid 1990's. He will cover what phreaking was, why it worked, and why it was done. Devices used, the theory behind them, and some entertaining stories about those devices are covered. He will cover the slew of 'secret' numbers that existed in the phone system and discuss the decline in phreaking with the newer versions of ESS.

episodes:43872.name: Shifting Security Left with Chris Merkel
episodes:43872.summary: The shift to the cloud is making it more difficult for security teams to control what happens in their organizations and secure systems. The solution is more security tools, more security people, and ever-inventive ways to reign in your environment. We'll talk about how engineering automation to create a culture of empowerment, self-reliance and trust can result in better security outcomes.

episodes:43872.name: Bug Bounty Law with Dr. Amit Elazari Bar On
episodes:43872.summary: Bug Bounties and Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) are one of the fastest growing, most popular ways for companies to engage with the security research community and uncover unknown security vulnerabilities. This talk will explore how the law interacts with bug bounties, VDP, anti-hacking laws, bounty legalese myths, and contract standardization efforts widely adopted across the industry.

episodes:43872.name: Automating Hashtopolis with Dustin Heywood
episodes:43872.summary: This talk will cover the basics of using the user-api to automate functions in Hashtopolis. Connecting to an HTP instance, creating hashlists, creating attacks, recovering plaintext, user creation and more will be covered.

episodes:43872.name: Welcome Our New A.I. Overlords with Ed Skoudis
episodes:43872.summary: Amazing new A.I. based services from Amazon, Google, and Microsoft let organizations rely on automated technology to crawl through their cloud-based data to identify sensitive info, security weaknesses, and hacking attempts. In this talk, Ed will analyze security implications, ethical, business, and privacy issues they raise as cloud-based A.I. intertwines itself in our lives deeper every day.

episodes:43872.name: Tracking an Adversary's Learning Curve with Edd Black
episodes:43872.summary: There are 2 camps of attackers: low skilled opportunists (script kiddies) and APT - Advanced Persistent Threats (funded organized crime, nation states). In between lurks a skilled persistent threat, capable of doing even more damage. These adversaries require human responders to identify, track, & oppose. Understand the constraints of the persistent threat, and you can learn to counter them.

episodes:43872.name: Remote Wireless Pentesting with Eric Escobar & Matt Orme
episodes:43872.summary: Wireless pentesting typically requires physical proximity to a target which requires time, limited resources, and constant traveling. Eric & Matt have pioneered an inexpensive device to covertly perform wireless pentests anywhere on earth. In this talk, they'll discuss why they built it, how it works, and why they think it will revolutionize wireless pentesting.

episodes:43872.name: Building a Cohesive Undergraduate Security Club with Ian Klatzco
episodes:43872.summary: The university security club had its ups and downs between boring meetings and inaccessibility to newcomers. It improved with a tighter meeting format, approachable 24-7 internal CTF, and internal documentation. There was better attendance, more people staying after meetings, and freshmen successfully completing projects with upperclassman mentorship. Interested? Learn more by watching this video.

episodes:43872.name: Encryption, Silver Bullets & Holy Water with J. Wolfgang Goerlich
episodes:43872.summary: Werewolves attack, we have silver bullets. Vampires attack, we have holy water. Criminal hackers attack, we have encryption. The villains come and the heroes fight back. But too often, encryption is like water without the holy or bullets without the silver. The configuration is wrong or the code is incomplete. This talk will cover how and where to architect for encryption to get real protection.

episodes:43872.name: Always Look a Gift (Trojan) Horse In the Mouth with James Arndt
Unhinging Security On the Buffalo Terastation NAS with Ian Sindermann
Decrypting the Mess that is Communication Security Negotiation with Jim Nitterauer
What are We Thinking Here? Rethinking Security with Jeff Man
Sorry About Your WAF with Johnny Xmas & Sam Crowther
What the World Needs Now is Ham, Sweet Ham with Jonathan Tomek
Spelunking the Bitcoin Blockchain with Josh Bressers
Thrift Shopping with your Data with Josh Frantz
Capture the Fail - Avoiding Pitfalls when running your C.T.F. with Kris & Chris Silvers
Anatomy of a Hot Wallet: Bitcoin at Scale with Matthew Werner
Don't Forget to Wipe with Michael Portera
What Happens when a Genome Database is Breached with Michelle Meas
Urban Foraging: Back to our Beginnings with Nick Wersel
Journey to Command Injection with Rick Ramgattie
Micro and Nano Segmentation with Russ From
A look at Historic Cons & their Transition to a Digital World with Stephanie Carruthers
Bet You Never Played an NES Game Like This with Vi Grey
The X-15 Rocket Plane, Flying the First Wings into Space with Michelle Evans

show:f x.name: F/X: The Series
show:f x.summary: Rollie Tyler, a special effects expert, helps his detective friend solve crimes by making criminals see what they want to see. But what is real and what is illusion?

episodes:8852.name: The Illusion
episodes:8852.summary: Rollie helps a woman escape a bad relationship by turning her into a man and finds himself on the run from the Feds who want him for murder.

episodes:8852.name: The Illusion
episodes:8852.summary: Rollie helps a woman escape a bad relationship by turning her into a man and finds himself on the run from the Feds who want him for murder.

episodes:8852.name: Zero Hour
episodes:8852.summary: Terrorists have planted a car bomb somewhere in the city. Rollie and the team must convince the bomber to give up the location.

episodes:8852.name: High Risk
episodes:8852.summary: Things get personal when Leo's girlfriend is taken hostage, but Rollie isn't the only one putting on a show.

episodes:8852.name: Payback
episodes:8852.summary: Rollie is asked to work with a director who the team believes killed Angie's father. Things go awry and Angie looks guilty.

episodes:8852.name: The Ring
episodes:8852.summary: Rollie creates a fake chop shop to catch a crook who always gets off the hook.

episodes:8852.name: Dingo
episodes:8852.summary: Rollie's dad Dingo is heavily in debt to a bookie and Rollie must raise the funds fast.

episodes:8852.name: White Light
episodes:8852.summary: Angie finds her friend dead and all his discs and hard drive missing. He was doing a story on the Air Force and aliens, what did he find out that they didn't want published?

episodes:8852.name: The Brotherhood
episodes:8852.summary: A cop buddy of Leo's is found dead of an apparent suicide. Leo knows it's a frame up and is determined to clear his friend's name.

episodes:8852.name: French Kiss
episodes:8852.summary: When a stuntman is killed on set, the team becomes a target as they have the bomber on film and can identify him.

episodes:8852.name: Eye of the Dragon
episodes:8852.summary: An old flame of Rollie's pops up on his movie shoot complicating matters.

episodes:8852.name: Target
episodes:8852.summary: Leo and Rollie attempt to catch an elusive and cunning sniper called the Wolf.

episodes:8852.name: Supernote
episodes:8852.summary: Leo goes after the son of a diplomat who claims immunity after he runs down and kills a cop.

episodes:8852.name: Medea
episodes:8852.summary: A stalker is terrifying an old actress friend of Rollie's.

episodes:8852.name: Shivaree
episodes:8852.summary: Leo seeks justice for a guy made paraplegic during an armoured car heist. The thieves got away but one went to prison and the money can't be recovered until all the thieves are together.

episodes:8852.name: Gemini
episodes:8852.summary: While visiting Rollie on a set, Leo is intrigued by a Gemini sign tattooed on the nape of Lucinda's neck, as it reminds him a case investigated a few years ago. With the help of a former victim, Leo is willing to finally solve this case.

episodes:8852.name: Double Image
episodes:8852.summary: As New York City's mayor is announcing the donation of 20 city buses to Sarajevo, Jace Emery is striking a deal to smuggle computers to North Korea under the cover of a city bus.

episodes:8852.name: Quicksilver
episodes:8852.summary: During the presentation of a smart probe, an FBI raid is conducted and Rollie is taken into custody.

episodes:8852.name: Get Fast
episodes:8852.summary: After an accident caused on a set by a drug addict stunt, Rollie decides to help Jerry Tamblin investigate on a major drug production gang.

episodes:8852.name: Bad Influence
episodes:8852.summary: The day before the holidays, Rollie is finishing a student movie. Forced to stay after the closing of the school, he is witness, with two students, of the hijacking of an armored truck.

episodes:8852.name: Reunion
episodes:8852.summary: Angie is contacted by an old college friend of hers, Yvonne Cherico, who is willing to meet her in town. At the meeting point, everything gets worse when Angie is kidnapped.

episodes:8852.name: Script Doctor
episodes:8852.summary: Rollie gets lured in by an old acquaintance to be an assistant director on a low-budget film that has more going on behind the scenes than Rollie and Angie know. Francis deals with being suspended from the force and Leo considers a new employment avenue.

episodes:8852.name: Requiem for a Cop
episodes:8852.summary: Leo McCarthy's death in a massive explosion is just the beginning of Rollie's nightmare. An internal investigation into police corruption points the finger at Leo and Francis Gatti. When Rollie is implicated in a scheme to resell weapons impounded by the police, he hits the street—on the run from the NYPD.

episodes:8852.name: Unfinished Business
episodes:8852.summary: A mob accountant on the run pulls Rollie back into the unfinished investigation of Leo's murder. The accountant will finger his boss, Vincent Capricio, for Leo's death if Rollie helps him disappear.

episodes:8852.name: Siege
episodes:8852.summary: A quick bank withdrawal turns into a hostage situation with Angie in the middle. On location at a new movie, Rollie has all the high-tech gear he needs to make life miserable for the hostage-takers. But the operation is turned on its head when one of the criminals turns out to have a strange hold on Mira.

episodes:8852.name: Shooting Mickey
episodes:8852.summary: When Angie joined up with young, twitchy director Levi Chase and her old school friend Kit Marchado, she figured making a Gonzo film would be a gas. But the premise behind the film—breaching a high security penthouse to get a photo of reclusive, retired mobster Mickey O'Brien—is also a blueprint for murder.

episodes:8852.name: Deep Cover
episodes:8852.summary: On location in London, the last person Rollie expected to see was FBI agent Elena Serrano. This time she needs Rollie's help in spiriting an undercover agent back to New York with his deadly cargo of bio-toxin.

episodes:8852.name: House of Horrors
episodes:8852.summary: Supermodel Danielle Vandenglas is the star of "House of Horrors" but death is her stand-in—and Rollie Tyler is her only hope for survival.

episodes:8852.name: High Roller
episodes:8852.summary: When the body of a Scotland Yard Inspector plummets from the sky and lands in the middle of New York City, a messy case lands on Mira's desk.

episodes:8852.name: Ritual
episodes:8852.summary: Mangela, an Australian aborigine, tracks a stolen artifact to New York, but needs Rollie's strength and expertise to recover it from a renegade tribesman. Rollie undertakes the quest of a lifetime, to save his friend and face down his own primitive fears in the ultimate one-on-one challenge.

episodes:8852.name: Spanish Harlem
episodes:8852.summary: A frantic phone call from Mira's ex-husband sends Rollie and Mira on a rescue mission into the old hood. But things go bad when the van is ripped off and a squad of high-tech killers joins the pursuit.

episodes:8852.name: Flashback
episodes:8852.summary: With Rollie's help, the assassination of a US Senator is recreated in a movie, and then in real life—with the original assassin.

episodes:8852.name: Standoff
episodes:8852.summary: Rollie and Angie do Mira a favor by providing cover for a young federal witness. The situation explodes in their faces when a high-tech motorcycle gang tracks them down and besieges them in an abandoned farm.

episodes:8852.name: Vigilantes
episodes:8852.summary: It's revenge twice over when Ricky Delacruz escapes justice and goes after the man who almost put him away: Rollie Tyler. But his victim ends up being Angie, and Rollie sets out to even the score... no matter what it takes.

episodes:8852.name: Reaper
episodes:8852.summary: Random deaths in Kansas, the cold-blooded murder of a militia cell in Pennsylvania, the apparent suicide of a government scientist in New York—threads that lead Rollie and Mira into a shadowy world where nothing is as it seems.

episodes:8852.name: Inferno
episodes:8852.summary: To clear his name when he is blamed for a fire on set, Rollie probes the twisted psyche of a high-tech arsonist with the help of one of his victims.

episodes:8852.name: Evil Eye
episodes:8852.summary: When a young girl is kidnapped from Rollie's set and sealed into an airtight chamber, Rollie and Mira must race the clock to rescue her when she is only given 24 hours to live.

episodes:8852.name: Chiller
episodes:8852.summary: Rollie, Angie, and Mira enter the world of life after death to solve the murder of a hapless drifter.

episodes:8852.name: Thief
episodes:8852.summary: Rollie and Angie get to put on the Ritz as they become cat burglars to the rich and famous to lure the reclusive super-thief Sebastian from his high-tech lair.

episodes:8852.name: Red Storm
episodes:8852.summary: Loubar is back—with a vengeance. His assignment: to kill the Chinese Trade Minister. Using Rollie's identity, and three days stolen from his life, Loubar constructs a perfect frame. Unless Rollie stops the assassination, his life as a free man is over.

show:bandits.name: Time Bandits
show:bandits.summary: Time Bandits is an unpredictable journey through time and space with a ragtag group of thieves and their newest recruit: an 11-year-old history buff named Kevin. Together, they set out on a thrilling quest to save the boy's parents - and the world. Guided by Lisa Kudrow, the eccentric crew of bandits embark on epic adventures while evil forces threaten their conquests and life as they know it. As the group transports through time and space, the gang stumbles upon fascinating worlds of the distant past while seeking out treasure, depending on Kevin to shed light on each situation. The Time Bandits witness the creation of Stonehenge, see the Trojan Horse in action, escape dinosaurs in the prehistoric ages, wreak havoc during medieval times, experience the ice age, ancient civilizations, the Harlem Renaissance, and much more along the way.

episodes:37926.name: Kevin Haddock
episodes:37926.summary: A boy struggles to make the most of everyday life—until a bumbling gang of thieves lands in his bedroom.

episodes:37926.name: Mayan
episodes:37926.summary: On a whirlwind journey to ancient Mexico, Kevin and the Bandits take part in a feast. Pure Evil sends huntress Fianna on a quest.

episodes:37926.name: Medieval
episodes:37926.summary: The Bandits pose as dragon slayers in England and feel the wrath of a wicked sheriff. Saffron embarks on her own search for answers.

episodes:37926.name: Prohibition
episodes:37926.summary: Kevin and the Bandits run for their lives during New York's Harlem Renaissance. Saffron and an ally work to outwit enemies in Japan.

episodes:37926.name: Georgian
episodes:37926.summary: While searching for Kevin's home, the Bandits cross paths with Casanova and the Earl of Sandwich. Penelope is challenged to a duel.

episodes:37926.name: Mansa Musa
episodes:37926.summary: The Bandits scour the desert for a missing member and hatch a plan to rob history's richest man. Widgit delves into the mysteries of the Map.

episodes:37926.name: Ice Age
episodes:37926.summary: Saffron saves the day in an icy situation. Penelope faces off with a tribal chief. Bittelig puts his heart into a rescue mission.

episodes:37926.name: Home Again
episodes:37926.summary: Kevin and Saffron return to Bingley…but it's 1996 and their parents are children. Fianna continues her chase and crashes a goth party.

episodes:37926.name: Pell-Mell
episodes:37926.summary: The gang sets out to find the missing piece of the Map. Kevin comes face-to-face with the Supreme Being, who offers a tempting deal.

episodes:37926.name: Fortress of Darkness
episodes:37926.summary: Season finale. Despite impossible odds, Kevin, Saffron, and the Bandits venture into the Fortress of Darkness to save Kevin's parents.

show:king solomon s mines.name: King Solomon's Mines
show:king solomon s mines.summary: King Solomon's Mines is set against the backdrop of 19th century Africa. Based on H. Rider Haggard's wildly popular novel, the excitement unfolds around heroic explorer Allan Quatermain, a grieving widower fighting for custody of his young son. Hired by the beautiful daughter of an Oxford professor to find her father--who has vanished without a trace – Quatermain returns to the Dark Continent and embarks on a dangerous quest to rescue the captive archeologist, who holds the key to untold treasures--and ultimate power.

episodes:43495.name: Part 1
episodes:43495.summary: Renowned safari hunter Allan Quatermain is lured back into the unknown recesses of the African jungles to find a man who disappeared while searching for the fabled King Solomon`s Mines-a destination of legendary riches from which no soul has ever returned alive.

episodes:43495.name: Part 2
episodes:43495.summary: No one knows if the fabled tomb exists. It's been said that whoever finds it will become the richest soul on the face of the earth- some say, the most cursed. Now, one brave man has been hired to find out what is truth, what is myth, and what is really buried in the darkness of King Solomon's Mines.

show:the great escape.name: The Great Escape
show:the great escape.summary: The Great Escape is a game show where the cast members have to work together to escape a secret room.

episodes:39120.name: Korea Genome Bank II, Evil Prison I
St. Matthew Jo's Psychiatric Hospital I
St. Matthew Jo's Psychiatric Hospital II

show:over the top.name: Over the Top
show:over the top.summary: After being fired from the soap opera Days to Remember, down on his luck, eccentric, self-centered actor Simon Ferguson moves into Manhattan's Metropolitan Hotel, which is run by ex-wife Hadley Martin, whom he was married to 20 years prior... for twelve days. Despite her initial exasperation with her ex, Hadley again succumbs to the "Ferguson charm", as do all of those around her. Simon reluctantly plays role model to Hadley's children from a different marriage: precocious 7 1⁄2-year-old Daniel and angst-ridden teen Gwen. The hotel's psychotic Greek chef, Yorgo Galfanikos, also looks up to Simon, having been a fan of his soap opera and films. Also seen are Rose, the hotel's assistant manager, Robert McSwain, the hotel's main investor, Tommy Sutton, a popular jock Gwen fawns over, and Jesse, a geek who is smitten with Gwen.

episodes:53696.name: It's Gwen's Party and Hadley'll Cry If She Wants To

show:dark blue.name: Dark Blue
show:dark blue.summary: Officer Carter Shaw and his team go undercover - sometimes too deep, among the criminals of modern-day Los Angeles.

episodes:937.name: Pilot
episodes:937.summary: Carter Shaw tries to take down a gang leader responsible for torturing an FBI agent and leaving him for dead. He also trains his newest team member, a fetching patrol cop who proves to be an expert prevaricator.

episodes:937.name: Guns, Strippers and Wives
episodes:937.summary: Ty goes undercover to take down a gun trafficker, but he breaks crucial rules by seeing his wife on her birthday, potentially blowing his cover. Carter must obtain a cool $100,000 to protect Ty's mission---and save his life.

episodes:937.name: Purity
episodes:937.summary: The sting is on when Carter's team targets a sly drug dealer with a professional background in law.

episodes:937.name: K-Town
episodes:937.summary: Ty and Dean team up to crush a rough-hewn Korean mob boss, but tension grows between the two undercover men when Ty works cautiously and Dean adopts a rash, less careful approach.

episodes:937.name: August
episodes:937.summary: The team scrambles to rescue an abducted woman before her captor kills her. The deep undercover mission features Ty as a hood, Dean as a security guard and Jaimie risking all by posing as a potential victim. But FBI interference disrupts the case, raising Carter's ire.

episodes:937.name: Ice
episodes:937.summary: The team goes deep in the shadows to trounce a crime ring that is planning a big diamond heist, with Dean and Jaimie establishing rapport with a major player by posing as a married couple. Meanwhile, Melissa informs Ty that she wants to start a family, a development that causes Ty to reconsider his dangerous profession.

episodes:937.name: O.I.S.
episodes:937.summary: The undercover team pursues a crooked yet decorated cop, but this assignment to crush a fellow police officer hits Ty's conscience hard---particularly after his wife floors him with big news.

episodes:937.name: Venice Kings
episodes:937.summary: The covert crew penetrates a turf war between two feuding gangs, one of which is a new and highly dangerous pack that's trying to seize the heroin market. In other developments, Ty's cash-strapped sister is in need of $7000, which Ty and Melissa can't provide.

episodes:937.name: Betsy
episodes:937.summary: Jaimie revisits her dark past when she goes undercover as her former self in a mission to crush a big-shot smuggler. For the case to succeed, she must reconnect with a bygone acquaintance---and ask a big favor of her boyfriend.

episodes:937.name: Shot in the Dark
episodes:937.summary: Carter surfaces as the prime suspect in an undercover officer's slaying. Meanwhile, Melissa pushes Ty to quit his dangerous undercover profession and start a family. And Jaimie's boyfriend lands a new job in San Francisco.

episodes:937.name: Urban Garden
episodes:937.summary: Carter and his undercover team joins forces with a sightly female FBI agent to crush a regional crime lord, but the case takes an ugly turn when Carter's close friend falls victim to tragedy.

episodes:937.name: Liar's Poker
episodes:937.summary: While working with an FBI agent, the undercover team tries to bust a drug ring tied to a Mexican drug cartel. As shadowy Ty slips into the big-money realm of a dealer, a beautiful art-gallery owner arises as a suspect.

episodes:937.name: Shelter of the Beast
episodes:937.summary: In a clandestine sting to squash an infamous drug-cartel king, Carter must masquerade as an adult-film impresario and Dean inches closer to their mark's daughter, a fetching art-gallery owner.

episodes:937.name: High Rollers
episodes:937.summary: The covert squad slips into the world of casinos to snoop into the disappearance of a gambling-addicted law student. It all gets dicey in this high-stakes realm when Ty goes too extreme in his role as a high roller. Meanwhile, Jaimie's risk-taking comes under scrutiny.

episodes:937.name: Brother's Keeper
episodes:937.summary: The covert unit aims to take down the notorious chieftain of an antigovernment militia. They stage a jailbreak and use his brother, now newly sprung from prison, as a pawn to locate him before he assassinates a federal judge. Meanwhile, Ty's job performance begins to suffer.

episodes:937.name: Jane Wayne
episodes:937.summary: The shadowy crew tries to bust a gang of drug thieves who are masquerading as DEA agents. The mission tasks an eager Jaimie to take on the identity of a junkie, while Ty and Dean must work with a sycophantic informant who aspires to be a cop.

episodes:937.name: Home Sweet Home
episodes:937.summary: Carter and his stealthy squad try to wipe out a home-invasion gang. While Ty assumes the identity of a thief, Alex and Carter pose as bait---but the mission is compromised when their target learns about the sting.

episodes:937.name: Shell Game
episodes:937.summary: Possible crooked behavior by a renowned figure in the black community rises to the surface in the wake of a young black man's shooting death. The case turns deeply personal for Ty, whose girlfriend has a tie to the shooting.

episodes:937.name: Dead Flowers
episodes:937.summary: The team slithers into the undercover shadows to bust two drug-smuggling brothers who are using a flower business as a front, but the case begins to wilt when Homeland Security interferes. Yet there's some blooming: Dean asks Jaimie on a proper date. Meanwhile, Ty is conflicted about his divorce, and a game-changing development impacts Carter.

episodes:937.name: Personal Effects
episodes:937.summary: Season 2 closes with the crew advancing on two drug-smuggling brothers, but they hope to pin down a larger prize: a terrorist scheming to smuggle dirty-bomb components into the U.S. Meanwhile, a job opens up in Miami for Alex; a conflicted Ty muses deeply about his divorce.

show:thief.name: Thief
show:thief.summary: Thief focuses on a crew of thieves led by Nick Atwater who find themselves in profound danger and at a moral crossroads. It also follows the unlikely father-daughter relationship between Atwater and his 14-year-old stepdaughter, who forces him to confront the lies which have defined his carefully ordered world. While the crew tries to pull off the most dangerous heist of their career, stealing $40 million from the U.S. government earmarked for the war on drugs in South America, their lives are complicated by the guilt they feel at the murder of one of their own, a crooked cop looking to clean up his own image with a big takedown, and a terminally ill killer sent by the Chinese Mafia looking to settle a score of their own.

episodes:4498.name: Pilot
episodes:4498.summary: Nick Atwater is a thief who has always kept his professional and personal lives separate, but those worlds collide when family tragedy strikes in the aftermath of a botched high-stakes heist.

episodes:4498.name: I Ain't Goin' to Jail for Anyone
episodes:4498.summary: Grief-stricken after his wife's sudden death, Nick prepares for her funeral as tensions mount with his step daughter, Tammi.

episodes:4498.name: Everything That Rises Must Converge
episodes:4498.summary: Roz's murder leaves Nick and his crew without a vital piece of information for the heist, and makes it clear that the Chinese are closing in on them.

episodes:4498.name: No Direction Home
episodes:4498.summary: After a standoff with Vincent and Shrimp Boy, Nick realizes he must find a safe place to hide Tammi. Tensions boil over between Gabo and Jack, and Gabo comes clean about a problem that affects the plan for the heist.

episodes:4498.name: Flight
episodes:4498.summary: The day of the heist arrives, but the plan is put in jeopardy when Nick gets an unexpected visit from Hayes and discovers Tammi has run away.

episodes:4498.name: In the Wind
episodes:4498.summary: With the Feds on their trail, the guys scramble to get the money and themselves out of New Orleans. Nick learns that someone he trusted has turned on him.

show:rush.name: Rush
show:rush.summary: USH examines the world of renegade physician Dr. William Rush (Tom Ellis, "Miranda"), a "medical fixer" who privately caters to LA's elite and whose service comes with a hefty price tag. Though the hard-partying doctor claims that he doesn't make judgments about his less-than-squeaky-clean clients, he's not immune to the ugliness that he encounters.

episodes:1706.name: Pilot
episodes:1706.summary: The doctor runs into an old flame.

episodes:1706.name: Don't Ask Me Why
episodes:1706.summary: Dr. Rush meets different clients in need of a fast, discreet medical "fix".

episodes:1706.name: Learning to Fly
episodes:1706.summary: Rush has to deal with a medical emergency and attempts to reach out to his estranged father. Eve needs to confront somebody from her past.

episodes:1706.name: We Are Family
episodes:1706.summary: Rush's lunch with his stepmother results in an unexpected outcome. Alex's marriage becomes under more pressure to his relationship with Rush.

episodes:1706.name: Where Is My Mind?
episodes:1706.summary: To try and cope with his anxiety, Rush takes any medical calls he gets. Eve discovers how valued she is.

episodes:1706.name: You Spin Me Round
episodes:1706.summary: While attending a medical conference, Rush and Alex plan a guys' weekend. Rush bumps into his ex and treats a politician. Eve tries to start again with Lucas.

episodes:1706.name: Because I Got High
episodes:1706.summary: Rush is introduced to a powerful hallucinogen that changes his perspective entirely. Alex gets a glimpse of Rush's lifestyle. Eve becomes concerned after belongings disappear from her apartment.

episodes:1706.name: Get Lucky
episodes:1706.summary: Rush is not pleased when he learns that Sarah has changed. Eve has some time with Manny and Alex maybe in too deep.

episodes:1706.name: Dirty Work
episodes:1706.summary: Sarah's efforts to find a sperm donor complicates things with Rush. Alex attempts to contain the fallout with his wife. Eve is encouraged to think about future possibilities.

episodes:1706.name: Bitter Sweet Symphony
episodes:1706.summary: Rush continues to be haunted by a ghost from his past. Eve has to deal with ramifications from seeing her ex. Steffi has a shocking proposal.

show:ronin.name: Ronin Warriors
show:ronin.summary: After a thousand years of exile, Talpa, ruler of the Netherworld, returns to claim the Earth as his own. The only thing that can stop him and his minions are five young men and their mystical suits of armor.

The Secret of the Wildfire Armor
The Trap of Naaza, Warlord of Venom
Rajura, the Warlord of Illusion's Trick
Wildfire Rescues Toma of the Heavens
Break Through the Gates of Doom
Seiji! The Fierce Battle in the Darkness!

The Legend of the Armor Revealed!
White Blaze Lays Down His Life
Get Mad, Shu! Defeat the Sand Demons
The Mysterious Appearance of the Evil Priestess Kayura
Legend of the Armor Called Inferno
Earth Spirit Army's Campaign of Terror

show:kalifornia.name: Kalifornian Kommando
show:kalifornia.summary: Van Hamilton's first ever trip to his mother's homeland, Finland, takes a wrong turn as soon as he gets off the plane. The 23-year-old kid from California was supposed to have a five-star holiday with his girlfriend Rachel. Instead, he is handcuffed and sent to faraway army barracks to be trained as a commando.

show:the mod squad.name: The Mod Squad
show:the mod squad.summary:
The Mod Squad is a police drama that features three young, hip crime fighters. One White, One Black, One Blonde, was the promotional hype line. The casting was intended to appeal to a youthful, counterculture audience. The basic premise was that the youthful investigators were offered work fighting crime as an alternative to being incarcerated themselves. The show's primary premise centered on the three cops using their youthful, hippie personas as a guise to get close to the criminals they investigated. The show was moderately popular during its initial run of five seasons. The show portrayed a multicultural society and dealt with issues of racial politics, drug culture, and counterculture.

The series earned six Emmy Award nominations, four Golden Globe nominations plus one win for Peggy Lipton, one Directors Guild of America Award, and four Logies.

episodes:3847.name: The Teeth of the Barracuda
episodes:3847.summary:
After one of Greer's undercover associates was murdered at a psychedelic nightclub, he puts his newly formed undercover squad of young adults, all previously in trouble with the law, to work investigating, which the evidence suggests was the work of young people. 

Note: Produced as a 90 minute pilot (73 minutes without commercials), this episode was edited for a 60 minute slot.

episodes:3847.name: Bad Man on Campus
episodes:3847.summary: Following the death of a high school teacher, the Squad work undercover at her school to investigate a juvenile car theft ring, and the circumstances that led to the teacher's death.

episodes:3847.name: My, What a Pretty Bus
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad go undercover in a prison to investigate one case but accidentally stumble onto another one involving counterfeiters.

episodes:3847.name: When Smitty Comes Marching Home
episodes:3847.summary: Linc tries to help an old friend, a returning Vietnam War soldier, after he is framed for the murder of a policemen.

episodes:3847.name: You Can't Tell the Players Without a Programmer
episodes:3847.summary: Julie serves as a decoy as the Mod Squad attempts to sting a computer dating service operating in blackmail.

episodes:3847.name: A Time to Love - A Time to Cry
episodes:3847.summary: A photographer wakes up in his studio and discovers his model is dead. The Squad works to clear him of her murder.

episodes:3847.name: Find Tara Chapman!
episodes:3847.summary: A young woman arrives in L.A. not knowing she has meningitis. The Squad desperately tries to find her, but she thinks they're really looking to kill her, as she witnessed a mob hit back East.

episodes:3847.name: The Price of Terror
episodes:3847.summary: The squad searches for the assailant behind the attempts on Greer's life, leading to the kidnapping of Julie in exchange for Greer.

episodes:3847.name: A Quiet Weekend in the Country
episodes:3847.summary: Pete, Linc and Julie go undercover as vacationers in a rural trailer camp to investigate the death of a narcotics informant.

episodes:3847.name: Love
episodes:3847.summary: Pete's cousin Karen turns to kidnapping to gain her parents attention after they are distracted by the new baby.

episodes:3847.name: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Starlet
episodes:3847.summary: When several young, blonde actresses are murdered by a serial strangler, Julie goes undercover as an aspiring actress, hoping to catch the killer.

episodes:3847.name: The Guru
episodes:3847.summary: Posing as hippies the trio investigate the bombing of an underground paper, resulting in murder.

episodes:3847.name: The Sunday Drivers
episodes:3847.summary: Linc is convinced that the death of his stunt driver friend was not accidental. The trio investigates and uncover a drug smuggling operation.

episodes:3847.name: Hello Mother, My Name Is Julie
episodes:3847.summary: Julie's mother, a former prostitute, arrives in Los Angeles to introduce Julie to the man she plans to marry: a bank robber under investigation by Pete and Linc.

episodes:3847.name: Flight Five Doesn't Answer
episodes:3847.summary: While transporting a prisoner by commercial airline, Pete, Linc and Greer face death in a forced plane crash, brought on by the prisoner's foes on the ground.

episodes:3847.name: Shell Game
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and Linc successfully infiltrate a gang of thieves only to discover they are protected by crooked cops and that Julie has become an unwitting hostage.

episodes:3847.name: Fear Is the Bucking Horse
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and Linc go undercover in a rodeo after a movie stuntman is nearly killed by an unknown shooter.

episodes:3847.name: A Hint of Darkness, A Hint of Light
episodes:3847.summary: Blind author Jenny Wills is viciously attacked on the beach by an unknown assailant, who makes repeated attempts on her life. Unbeknownst to her, he thinks she saw him commit a crime.

episodes:3847.name: The Uptight Town
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad searches for Captain Greer, who has disappeared while vacationing in a little desert town, only to find the townspeople not particularly helpful.

episodes:3847.name: A Reign of Guns
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad tangles with a wealthy arch-conservative who is forming a private militia armed with stolen guns.

episodes:3847.name: A Run for the Money
episodes:3847.summary: Pete's girlfriend gets him tangled up in a mess involving her convict father and stolen money.

episodes:3847.name: Child of Sorrow, Child of Light
episodes:3847.summary: Julie poses as an unwed mother to infiltrate an extortion racket that blackmails parents of adopted babies.

episodes:3847.name: Keep the Faith, Baby
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad is assigned to protect the life of a black priest who was defrocked for his liberal views on society, before being threatened by a murderer who is afraid he will break his seal of confession.

episodes:3847.name: Captain Greer, Call Surgery
episodes:3847.summary: Someone is stealing narcotics from area hospitals and Greer has the team go undercover in what he thinks will be the next target.

episodes:3847.name: Peace Now - Arly Blau
episodes:3847.summary: Linc and Pete go undercover as prison inmates to protect the life of a convicted draft dodger (and old friend of Julie's), whose father is a General in the Vietnam War.

episodes:3847.name: A Seat by the Window
episodes:3847.summary: After someone is killed at a bus station, the killer is believed to have escaped in one of three outgoing buses. Linc, Pete, and Julie each board one of the buses to track the possible killer.

episodes:3847.name: The Girl in Chair Nine
episodes:3847.summary: Capt. Greer reluctantly enlists the aid of a psychic to help find a kidnapped coed.

episodes:3847.name: My Name Is Manolete
episodes:3847.summary: Julie takes in a young, apparently destitute, Mexican boy, not realizing that he is connected to a couple of thieves who don't want him talking to the wrong people.

episodes:3847.name: An Eye for an Eye
episodes:3847.summary: Greer falls in love with an attractive widow, unwittingly making her the kidnapping target of a narcotics gang.

episodes:3847.name: Ride the Man Down
episodes:3847.summary: While on vacation Pete befriends a woman who tells him her brother is missing. When she is found dead he's charged with her murder.

episodes:3847.name: To Linc - With Love
episodes:3847.summary: Linc is initially bummed about having to get his driver's license renewed until he meets the examiner. They start dating but a man from her past comes back into her life and causes problems.

episodes:3847.name: Lisa
episodes:3847.summary: The squad is unaware that the writer they are assigned to protect has a split personality.

episodes:3847.name: Confrontation!
episodes:3847.summary: As dissident students prepare to demand changes in a school policy, a black student is found murdered on campus and the Squad is called in to investigate.

episodes:3847.name: Willie Poor Boy
episodes:3847.summary: An illiterate small time crook gets caught when he can't read the sign warning of danger. The squad rallies to help him if he cooperates with the law and snitches on his partner, who is responsible for the death of the security guard.

episodes:3847.name: The Death of Bill Hannachek
episodes:3847.summary: Julie goes undercover as a country singer at a wayside inn while Pete and Linc investigate the suspicious death of a faded country western star.

episodes:3847.name: A Place to Run, A Heart to Hide In
episodes:3847.summary: Pete, Linc and Julie go undercover at Sims College to investigate a frat boy's mysterious death. Pete plays a running back, Linc an African exchange student, and Julie the object of desire for the star quarterback.

episodes:3847.name: The Healer
episodes:3847.summary: The Mod Squad sets to work busting an extortion racket run by a self styled healer responsible for the death of Linc's friend. Julie befriends a wheelchair bound man paying large sums for empty promises that his paralysis will be cured.

episodes:3847.name: In This Corner - Sol Alpert
episodes:3847.summary: When Pete and Linc's friend Sol Alpert finds his business vandalized, he then learns it was done in protest over living conditions in ghetto housing owned by his own cousin. Sol decides to fight his cousin to get improvements in the housing, and with Pete, Linc, and Julie's help decides to bring the matter to a Jewish court.

episodes:3847.name: Never Give the Fuzz an Even Break
episodes:3847.summary: Pete, Linc, and Julie go undercover to trap a suave, charming veteran con man. His latest targets are three gullible elderly widows.

episodes:3847.name: The Debt
episodes:3847.summary: After a young man helps Pete when he is attacked by hoodlums, Pete learns the man's father may be plotting a serious crime.

episodes:3847.name: Sweet Child of Terror
episodes:3847.summary: An embittered handyman kidnaps Julie, mistaking her for the daughter of the woman who fired him.

episodes:3847.name: The King of Empty Cups
episodes:3847.summary: Chief Metcalf asks the squad to find his daughter, who has left home despondent after the death of her fiancé in Vietnam. They find her, addicted to drugs and part of a decadent rock star's coterie.

episodes:3847.name: A Town Called Sincere
episodes:3847.summary: While on a motorcycle trip to Mexico, Pete and Linc are detoured by a biker gang into a border town and held hostage along with all of the town's residents. The gang refuses to leave until they find out who in the town killed two of their members.

episodes:3847.name: The Exile
episodes:3847.summary: Julie's romance with a charming foreign exchange student turns dangerous when it's revealed that he's really a Middle Eastern Prince who's targeted for assassination by emissaries from his country.

episodes:3847.name: Survival House
episodes:3847.summary: A founder of a halfway house for drug addicts is wrongfully accused of statutory rape of a minor. Pete and Linc work undercover as tenants to find the person who framed him.

episodes:3847.name: Mother of Sorrow
episodes:3847.summary: Pete's fraternity brother Curtis Bell casually tells him that he's going to kill a girl. When that very girl is found murdered, the trio investigate. Curtis happily tells them just how the murder was committed. But Pete and the others wonder if he really killed her, or is just trying to get attention from his neglectful mother.

episodes:3847.name: The Deadly Sin
episodes:3847.summary: A set of rosary beads found on a corpse are traced to a young novice, who witnessed her father, a Syndicate figure, commit the murder. The Squad tries to help her sort out the situation, while higher-up mobsters from out of state plot to kill the girl.

episodes:3847.name: A Time for Remembering
episodes:3847.summary: As the trio reminisces over two years together, and Pete considers quitting the group to work with his father, an old nemesis arrives: Beau Graves, one of those they helped put in jail in the premier episode. He has just been paroled and has come seeking revenge against the trio.

episodes:3847.name: Return to Darkness, Return to Light
episodes:3847.summary: Janny Wills, first introduced in the first season episode "A Hint Of Darkness, A Hint Of Light", invites Linc, Pete, and Julie to meet her new fiancé, Dr. Frank Tarver. Tarver doesn't tell them that he is being threatened by a man blaming him for his daughter's death. But when the trio investigates further, they find that Tarver may not be who he seems.

episodes:3847.name: Call Back Yesterday
episodes:3847.summary: Pete visits his Beverly Hills home to try to help his old girlfriend, who believes her father is being kept in a mental ward against his will and manipulated by her uncle and cousin. While there, Pete also reunites with his mother.

episodes:3847.name: Should Auld Acquaintance Be Forgot!
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad goes undercover on a movie set to aid a director whose film is being sabotaged. The film is based on a real life murder case from twenty years before that Greer worked on.

episodes:3847.name: The Loser
episodes:3847.summary: After he tries to stop a runaway car, the son of a former cop and friend of Captain Greer is charged with stealing the vehicle. Then it is learned that the car, which belonged to a judicial candidate's campaign worker, was also involved in a hit and run. The trio goes undercover at the candidate's headquarters to further investigate.

episodes:3847.name: Long Road Home
episodes:3847.summary: Pete falls in love with a young woman he has injured in an auto chase involving a robbery suspect, only to learn she is the sister of the suspect.

episodes:3847.name: See the Eagles Dying
episodes:3847.summary: A friend of Captain Greer asks the trio to help find out what's bothering his daughter, who has been acting strangely since she's been associating with a group of motorcyclists who also engage in skydiving. The group let an old derelict go with them on a dive and jump, but the old man never opened his parachute.

episodes:3847.name: Who Are the Keepers, Who Are the Inmates?
episodes:3847.summary: Linc receives a desperate call from an old friend, now an inmate at a mental institution. Shortly afterward, the friend is dead of "heart failure", only the latest of a number of strange deaths at the place. Linc goes undercover as a patient at the institution, hoping to find out what's going on.

episodes:3847.name: 'A' Is for Annie
episodes:3847.summary: Julie comes to the assistance of her old teacher, who is being targeted by others in her community for teaching sex education in school.

episodes:3847.name: The Song of Willie
episodes:3847.summary: Linc works undercover as an assistant to his childhood friend, movie star Willie Rush, after an attempt on his life with an ill timed car bomb on the movie set. But concerning Linc more was Willie's cavalier lifestyle and attitude, created in part due to Willie's fear that he may have Huntington's disease.

episodes:3847.name: Search and Destroy
episodes:3847.summary: A hard nosed ex-cop returns from Vietnam to investigate the death of his brother, who was killed in a car accident just after he called him and told him that he had seen a murder, and that the murderer was an undercover cop.

episodes:3847.name: Just Ring the Bell Once
episodes:3847.summary: The trio becomes involved in the case of a young boy who's being raised in an orphanage. His mother is not taking care of him, but she does not want to give him up for adoption, and she is involved with a drug dealer.

episodes:3847.name: Welcome to the Human Race, Levi Frazee!
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and the Squad try to clear a young Apache falsely accused of murdering a man in a small desert town.

episodes:3847.name: A Far Away Place So Near
episodes:3847.summary: Linc comes to the airport to meet a friend who is returning from Vietnam, only to learn that he was killed by a sniper on the day he was supposed to go home. Suspicious of the story of how his friend died, he wonders if any of the four other servicemen in his unit who have returned know more than they are telling.

episodes:3847.name: A Time of Hyacinths
episodes:3847.summary: Julie becomes involved with a mysterious stranger, a movie actor believed to have died twenty years earlier.

episodes:3847.name: The Judas Trap
episodes:3847.summary: The head of a local campus ROTC is murdered, and the main suspect is the man's mentally disabled teenage son, whom he had frequently beaten. However, Pete and Linc, who have befriended the youth, believe he is innocent.

episodes:3847.name: Fever
episodes:3847.summary: A man on the run, with the son he doesn't have legal custody of, kidnaps Julie. However, as both have Rocky Mountain spotted fever, she is more concerned for their lives than hers.

episodes:3847.name: Is There Anyone Left In Santa Paula?
episodes:3847.summary: Following a death of an immigration agent at a car wash where an undocumented immigrant (and a friend of Pete's) work, the Squad finds a cop involved in the illegal entry of Mexican youths across the border - all tied to a village in Sonora. The officer and Greer are at odds on how to handle the case.

episodes:3847.name: A Short Course in War
episodes:3847.summary: An attention starved misfit gunman hell bent on starting a "war" with the establishment, infiltrates a student protest with Julie trapped as one of the hostages. Also among the hostages is her humanities teacher, who has a heart condition but left her medication in her car.

episodes:3847.name: Kicks Incorporated
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad investigates a unique nuisance racket headed by a man who turns out to be a close friend of Greer's.

episodes:3847.name: A Bummer for R.J.
episodes:3847.summary: Carl Betz plays a disillusioned solid citizen who becomes involved in the death of a hippie girl. He's seeking the girl's killer while his heartsick daughter searches desperately for him.

episodes:3847.name: The Hot, Hot Car
episodes:3847.summary: A car belonging to a businessman's associate has been stolen. However, the investigation becomes dire after Greer learns that that car was rigged with dynamite, as the businessman wanted to commit murder. The Squad rush to find the car before the dynamite explodes at 5 p.m., potentially killing an innocent family who rented it.

episodes:3847.name: Suffer, Little Children
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad helps a minister find out who murdered his brother, a psychologist who ran a clinic for troubled youngsters. Besides differing ideologies, complicating matters was that the clinic was used to hold stolen goods before they are fenced.

episodes:3847.name: Is That Justice? No, It's the Law
episodes:3847.summary: Greer and another veteran cop have both been frustrated by a drug pusher they've been trying to nail, who has twice had his case dismissed on legal technicalities. Finally, the third time appears to be the clincher, as the man is caught at an airport with a case full of heroin.

episodes:3847.name: A Double for Danger
episodes:3847.summary: A girl working undercover for a cop trying to bring down a drug lord is accidentally killed. Because of her resemblance to the dead girl, Julie is quickly recruited to impersonate her and continue in the mission, despite the great risk.

episodes:3847.name: Welcome to Our City
episodes:3847.summary: The trio tries to help a boy in his search for his father, who came to L.A. from West Virginia hoping to find work. It soon becomes apparent that there are people who don't want them to find the man, and that he is in debt to loan sharks.

episodes:3847.name: The Comeback
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad helps the son of an aging ex-boxing champ who is being harassed by gamblers for inside information on his dad's return to the ring after an 11-year absence.

episodes:3847.name: We Spy
episodes:3847.summary: While working undercover as safe crackers, Pete and Linc meet a timid, clumsy young man who asks them to teach him about their trade. They learn that the young man has a twin brother who is a successful businessman. What they don't know is that the businessman is actually the leader of the industrial spying ring they are trying to investigate. And that's only the start of the surprises to come.

episodes:3847.name: The Price of Love
episodes:3847.summary: When his motorcycle breaks down on a trip, Linc stops in an abandoned town, only to discover that a kidnapped boy is being held there for ransom. The kidnappers decide to hold Linc as well until they get the money.

episodes:3847.name: The Sentinels
episodes:3847.summary: While searching for a pair of murderers, the trio uncovers a link between murder, a stolen car and a threatened epidemic.

episodes:3847.name: Cricket
episodes:3847.summary: Julie and a young boy named Cricket go to the park where Cricket finds a gun dropped by a man he runs into. Cricket then accidentally shoots Julie and, thinking he's killed her, runs away.

episodes:3847.name: Home Is the Streets
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad pursues a dope pusher on the run for shooting two policemen.

episodes:3847.name: Survival
episodes:3847.summary: After Julie picks up a blind hitchhiker, they have a flat tire and flag down a passing car for help. Unfortunately, the people in the car trick them into switching cars and abandon them in the desert.

episodes:3847.name: Color of Laughter, Color of Tears
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad investigates a circus carnival that is being sabotaged before its opening day. The circus' owner vows the show will go on, despite it being in more danger of additional accidents.

episodes:3847.name: The Medicine Men
episodes:3847.summary: Julie falls in love with a young doctor who is being blackmailed by one of his fellow students from medical school.

episodes:3847.name: The Sands of Anger
episodes:3847.summary: Julie, Linc and Pete attend a dune buggy race where a pickup truck blows up, killing a young man Julie had just met. The trio then investigate the incident, suspecting foul play.

episodes:3847.name: The Poisoned Mind
episodes:3847.summary: Depressed after having shot a young man during a burglary, Greer takes time off to recover. However, while on vacation, he found himself poisoned by a slow acting poison that could kill him, leading to the Squad to go on a race against time to find the criminal.

episodes:3847.name: Exit the Closer
episodes:3847.summary: The trio helps a used car salesman who's made a deal with the devil.

episodes:3847.name: Whatever Happened to Linc Hayes?
episodes:3847.summary: Suffering from amnesia after getting mugged, Linc wanders Skid Row, unsure as to whether or not he is the escaped mental patient he reads about in a newspaper. The second clip show of the series, which includes flashbacks to previous episodes Bad Man on Campus, My, What a Pretty Bus, and Who Are the Keepers, Who Are the Inmates?

episodes:3847.name: And a Little Child Shall Bleed Them
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad tries to protect a TV clown whose life is in danger.

episodes:3847.name: The Loser
episodes:3847.summary: The Squad defends a drug dealer, whose daughter is a sick child in need of medical care; his associate has marked him for murder.

episodes:3847.name: Death of a Nobody
episodes:3847.summary: A woman is killed by a hit and run driver, but Pete is sure he was the intended victim.

episodes:3847.name: Feet of Clay
episodes:3847.summary: A young deaf-mute is credited as a hero after he saves a guard from a warehouse fire just as Pete, Linc, and Julie come upon the scene. But someone is trying to kill the young man, who seems ashamed by all the attention he's getting, and may know more than he's letting on.

episodes:3847.name: I Am My Brother's Keeper
episodes:3847.summary: Linc, Julie, and Greer race against time to find Pete, who has left the hospital prematurely after being run down by a car. He is determined to find out who murdered the friend he was meeting, and is unaware that he has a dangerous blood clot which could kill him. The killers of his friend are also looking for Pete, planning to kill him as well.

episodes:3847.name: Deal with the Devil
episodes:3847.summary: Pete is contacted by his old friend Rusty Bryson, a war correspondent whom he knew and idolized as a boy. But the Treasury department is looking for Bryson, who it suspects of smuggling drugs from Vietnam.

episodes:3847.name: Kill Gently, Sweet Jessie
episodes:3847.summary: A convicted murderer out on parole goes on a mission to kill Pete, who he mistakenly believes was responsible for a savage beating he suffered years earlier.

episodes:3847.name: Shockwave
episodes:3847.summary: Julie becomes emotionally attached to an abandoned baby whose parents are terrorizing the area with armed robberies.

episodes:3847.name: No More Oak Leaves for Ernie Holland
episodes:3847.summary: A Vietnam veteran returns to the police force with questionable ideas of dealing with dissident ghetto residents.

episodes:3847.name: The Cave
episodes:3847.summary: Julie, Linc and Pete break down in the desert during a sandstorm and seek shelter in an abandoned mine. An old man embittered by the death of his son in the war who hates hippies then sets off dynamite and traps the trio inside.

episodes:3847.name: The Wild Weekend
episodes:3847.summary: Pete is kidnapped and almost killed by the jealous boyfriend of his former fiancée.

episodes:3847.name: The Tangled Web
episodes:3847.summary: Pete and Linc come close to breaking the law as they attempt to help a parolee, an old friend of Julie's, return stolen jewelry.

episodes:3847.name: Outside Position
episodes:3847.summary: A stable boy's employer frames him for possessing drugs and continues conspiring against him after his parole, all in order to stop the young man's romance with his daughter.

episodes:3847.name: Big George
episodes:3847.summary: A man happens to witness the murder of a sales clerk and agrees to testify at the trial. As a result he and his family are relentlessly terrorized by someone, even after the trial has ended.

episodes:3847.name: The Connection (1)
